quality.review_scope: All 15 main and 15 SI pages independently read as text and actual page images. NaHTe preparation, MPA-CdTe synthesis, microwave GSH-AuNC synthesis, all eight hybrid-volume formulations, time optimization, storage series and all reported characterization controls are retained. Source ambiguities are explicit; no biological experiment or device fabrication is invented. Reference molecules/cells and morphology illustrations are not measured sample coordinates.
missing_fields: Physical batch identifiers are not supplied; no precise batch identity is inferred from repeated material names.
Specimen mounting/drying, charge referencing, detailed fit protocol and quantitative ligand coverage.
